title: backlog.py check warns when an item's goal names a gap finding its links lack
goal: Retrospective of SP-vayhvwfy: TK-xr7fgoia and TK-6emrxewd were filed with goals naming F-68c59a20a679 and F-114b1ea76574 but with neither research true nor a link to those findings, so backlog.py cost --research left them out and ST-dfxpv6i7's done refused until the links were added by hand. backlog.py check warns for an item whose goal names an F-<12 hex> gap finding its links do not name.

run: import re,subprocess,sys,tempfile;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();R=lambda*a:subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True);subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d],check=True);R('new','story','--title','Bare','--goal','Names F-0123456789ab and links nothing');b=R('new','story','--title','Linked','--goal','Names F-fedcba987654 and links it');R('set',re.search(r'ST-\w{8}',b.stdout).group(0),'--add-link','gap F-fedcba987654');o=R('check');t=o.stdout+o.stderr;ok='F-0123456789ab' in t and 'F-fedcba987654' not in t;print('check names only the unlinked gap finding:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 12 of 13, "Planning rules 2: plan-time warnings and probes"); the triage reviewer found it serves the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test F2: a content sprint from the research queue lands on headless Sonnet workers. Premise: backlog.py check on a store whose item goal names F-0123456789ab and links nothing prints no line naming it (the item's check). Run at plan 2026-10-10: exit 1, the check output names neither gap finding on the base, so the premise reproduces. The check is a throwaway store, so no test is needed.
